sourceFailure.firstShotSummary: Let the ocean breeze set the rhythm.
sourceFailure.finding: The planning prompt required shape, duration and non-empty strings but did not bind user-facing output language to the brief. The parser consequently accepted structurally valid English user-facing text for a Chinese brief.

repair.languageDetection: A brief containing a Han-script character selects zh-Hans planning validation.
repair.promptContract: Chinese briefs require Chinese title, synopsis, hooks, shot titles and shot lines; visual prompts may remain in another language.
repair.validationContract: Any required user-facing field without a Han-script character fails MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID.
repair.boundedHandling: The existing deterministic repair path receives the safe language-contract failure and remains capped at two total planning attempts.
